name: grid-list-02
title: Grid List with Links
description: A grid list with links block.

standards.purpose: Scan a set of similar items as a compact, uniform grid.
useWhen: Items are peers and are compared by their title and a small amount of metadata.
doNotUseWhen: Items need long descriptions or per-item actions that cannot fit a compact cell.

rules.check: Every cell shares one structure; mixing media and text-only cells breaks scanning.
Hover-only controls are reachable by keyboard and stay visible on focus.
An empty grid explains what would appear here.
